Subject: Redwood pilot procurement path & PO vs card question

Hi Tom / Evergarden procurement team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of narrow asks so we can line up commercial paperwork for the pilot: 

- Pilot scope we discussed: 2 dev seats + 50k inference tokens / month, hosted API, 3-month pilot.
- Procurement preferences you mentioned: prefer paper/PO for production contracts; card acceptable for short pilots if spend < $5k.

Two asks to confirm next steps:
1) Can you confirm AP gating thresholds (PO required above what $ threshold?) and typical PO lead time at Evergarden?
2) Do you accept vendor setup via our vendor portal or do you require your supplier form (happy to fill either)?

I’ve attached a short commercial one-pager and our W-9. If PO is the path, we’ll prepare a commercial SOW + invoice template (remit, tax details). If you prefer card for the pilot we can also enable card billing immediately to speed kickoff.

If you prefer, happy to route a redlined MSA/DocuSign to your procurement contact — let me know the procurement contact name/email and preferred flow.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm AP thresholds and vendor form preference by end of week (7/20)
- I send SOW + invoice template (if PO) or enable card billing (if card)

Thanks — Laura

Thanks Laura — good call earlier. Quick answers from AP side:

- PO requirement: Procurement requires a PO for any vendor spend over $10,000 USD. For pilots expected to be under $5k, corporate card is allowed but needs pre-approval from my manager.
- Vendor setup: We prefer vendors to complete our supplier form (attached). If the vendor is already in our system with a W-9 on file we can skip, but new vendors need the form + W-9.
- Marketplace: We generally avoid marketplace purchases for platform services due to data residency and contractual visibility concerns; prefer direct vendor contracting.

I’ve attached the Evergarden supplier form. Can you:
1) Fill the supplier form and return (I can open a vendor record once we have it)
2) Send the SOW + invoice template with remit and tax info (we need remit address to generate PO)

Tom
Procurement Lead
Evergarden Health
Attachment: evergarden_supplier_form.xlsx (stub)
